WELCOME
Welcome to
Philadelphia Animal Specialty & Emergency
PASE’s mission is to set the standard in patient-centered and community-based veterinary healthcare throughout Philadelphia and beyond. As a privately owned, non-corporate animal hospital we strive to support pet owners in understanding their pet’s health, evaluating medical decisions, and involving them as part of their animals' healthcare team. With doors open 24/7, PASE also has critical care specialists on-site and is available seven days a week! Whether your case is urgent or a specialty request, we are equipped and ready to serve you and your family. ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
Learn More

Anesthesiology & Analgesia
PASE’s Anesthesiology & Analgesia Department is led by Dr. Katie Zatroch, DVM, DACVAA, board-certified veterinary anesthesiologist.
Learn More
Critical Care
We have an Emergency & Critical Care specialist on site and available 7-days a week.
Learn More
Diagnostic Imaging
The Diagnostic Imaging department at PASE, overseen by Dr. Adam Yoskowitz, VMD, DACVR, provides a range of advanced medical imaging services including x-rays, ultrasound, CT scans, and MRI scans.
Learn More
Emergency Care
The emergency department at PASE remains open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, throughout the year to efficiently address any veterinary emergencies that may arise.
Learn More
Internal Medicine
PASE’s internal medicine department works alongside patients with difficult to manage diseases and diagnoses.
Learn More
Neurology
The neurology department at PASE is led by two board certified veterinary neurologists, who offer consultations 6 days a week and are readily available for emergency coverage 7 days a week.
Learn More
Oncology
PASE boasts a dedicated Oncology Department, led by the esteemed Dr. Lillie Davis, a highly skilled veterinarian specializing in the field of oncology.
Learn More
Surgery
PASE provides convenient surgical services directly at their location, covering various specialties such as orthopedic, soft tissue, and oncologic surgeries.
Learn More
